name: sciretriever-typescript-workspace
description: A general-purpose literature knowledge base for people and agents: find papers, get PDFs, turn them into searchable full text with evidence.

scripts.build: node scripts/vendor/ensure-mupdf.mjs && tsc -b && node scripts/prune-retired-runtime.mjs && node scripts/build-workbench-assets.mjs && node scripts/build-browser-extension.mjs && node scripts/build-agent-access.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig*.json eslint.config.mjs vitest.config.mjs scripts/**/*.mjs packages/**/*.ts "apps/**/*.{ts,tsx}" apps/web/*.mjs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig*.json eslint.config.mjs vitest.config.mjs scripts/**/*.mjs packages/**/*.ts "apps/**/*.{ts,tsx}" apps/web/*.mjs
scripts.quick: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck
scripts.full: pnpm quick && pnpm test && pnpm build
